## what it is
Workq monorepo: queue server, pool orchestrator, dashboard, worker CLI, domain/protocol
url: https://github.com/skatamatic/workq.git

## where things live
apps/server, apps/pool, apps/dashboard, packages/*, apps/pool/skills+rules
board / cards / transcript -> apps/dashboard/src
claim/resume/steer/park-resume -> apps/pool/src/orchestrator
domain SM / pipeline / review-watch -> packages/domain/src
HTTP API + merge poller + webhooks -> apps/server/src
worker CLI ($WQ) + evidence -> packages/worker/src
playbook/captain skills -> apps/pool/skills (fan-out to .cursor)
rules SoT -> apps/pool/rules (fan-out to .cursor/rules)
MemoryReader handoff -> apps/pool/src/memory/reader.ts

## conventions
Pool workq/wi_* heads OK (assert-branch-name --convention pool)
Workers filter: multi-select string[] (empty≡All); orch via groupWorkersByPool
Repos still sessionStorage-persisted separately
PR Evidence: Tests added + Vision verification; gates stay in Checks
Board Repos filter: bare name ≡ owner/name aliases
Rules + quality-bar fan out like skills; playbook↔.cursor mirrors stay identical
targetBase optional; pool forks from it (live stack dep still wins fork)
Self-review: mandatory reviewer Task→lenses; docs-only skip only
Local CI requires npm run build (covers dashboard tsconfig.app.json)
assert-pr-base: workq/* base needs a still-open dependency PR

## known friction
Handoff: Repo: workq first + --repo workq. Never npm i in linked wt — relink
Park-resume: lease as slot.workerId (park-resume.ts); e2e feedback/landing
Skill hard-deps auto-expand (playbook→reviewer-engine); preflight fails closed
Warm base bolt/spare @workq links break tsc — link-local-files --node-modules
Feature items need a PR — never finish as answered/review with no code

## recent activity
last routed 2026-07-29T07:06:43.804Z (766x)
park-resume lease; rules fan-out; memory handoff; targetBase

## ambiguous terms
pool: workq daemon (apps/pool), not Create. Unqualified pool ≈ workq.
dashboard: workq React board (apps/dashboard), not Create UI.
engine: not a workq term — almost always Create; ask or route to create.

## what it is
WorkLink Create web app: React client, workflow engine, ai-server
url: https://github.com/scopear/worklink-create-2.git

## where things live
client/ (React + workflow), webapp/ (viewport), services/ai-server/
workflow engine -> client/src/classes/workflow/engine
3D engine -> client/src/classes/Engine.ts
ai-server -> services/ai-server
viewport -> webapp/src/components/viewport
harness -> client/scripts + DESIGN_HARNESS.md; copy workflow-inspector triad

## conventions
Branch naming: WC20-<n>-Short-Title against develop
prefer squash into develop.
never open PR from workq/wi_* heads
ai-server recon: symlink .env + worklink-api.json from primary checkout
UI shots: client Playwright harness; not CMS/OAuth/Browser

## known friction
AssetAPI/AssetsManager: check GQLAssets shared flag first on wrong-asset bugs
Harness: INCLUDE_HARNESS=1; land --check-cmd 'cd client && npx tsc --noEmit'
Review wakes: resolve author/bot-last threads before submit or wait loops
Live AI graph: ensureResidentReady on first capture; not on project open
Workflow engine Qs: client/.../workflow/engine — read-only, no worktree
